scientific limitations/integrity.claim_scope: Exact classification and size enumerator for standard secure total dominating sets in finite connected complete multipartite graphs.
scientific limitations/integrity.correctness_limit: The exhaustive verifier covers all ordered part-size profiles with 2-5 parts, each size at most 4, and total order at most 9; the infinite theorem rests on the written proof, not on enumeration.
scientific limitations/integrity.date_integrity: 2008-01-01 is the earliest exact public calendar day verified for an inspected primary secure-total-domination source. The earlier 2007 foundational paper is acknowledged but no exact public day was verified, so none was invented.
scientific limitations/integrity.originality_limit: The 2007 foundational article was not available in full. Later full-text sources inspected do not state the all-cardinality enumerator, but poorly indexed older special-case literature remains a residual risk.

title: Secure-total-domination polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
